history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration formulate additional criteria for future exceptional use of special commitments and continue to take appropriate action on the remaining balances in line with the provisions of the Financial Regulations and Rules of the United Nations.
history.administration_response: The guidelines on the use of special commitments, which are to be used on an exceptional basis, were presented to the Fifth Committee of the General Assembly at the first part of the resumed seventy- ninth session, in the report of the Secretary-General on improving the financial situation of the United Nations (A/79/734).
history.board_assessment: Given that the guidelines on the future exceptional use of special commitments were presented to the General Assembly in the report of the Secretary- General on improving the financial situation of the United Nations (A/79/734), and that there are no remaining balances, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
